I recommend **approve**. Every requirement in the SOP is met and none of the risk factors apply.

- **Ownership (3.3):** Rosa Zhou holds 20%, Vera Nakamura 27% and Tara Nakamura 33%. That leaves 20% with an unknown holder. No one unidentified could reach 25% from that share, so ownership counts as complete. Vera and Tara are the two people at 25% or more, and both are identified. The owner certification matches the ownership table.
- **Control person (3.2):** Rosa Zhou, the Chief Executive Officer.
- **Identity checks (3.4):** All three people's identity checks came back verified.
- **Registry filing (3.5):** Filed 2026-04-05, so it is about 7 months old at review on 2026-10-27. That is inside the 12-month limit.
- **Screening (4.1–4.4):** No sanctions match on the business or any of the three people. None is a politically exposed person. No adverse media was found.
- **Industry (5.1–5.3):** The industry is listed as normal, so the unverified state licence doesn't matter.
- **Geography (6.1–6.2):** The business and all three people are in the US, with US nationality.

The evidence system shows the adverse-media result only as "no". It doesn't include the search terms, date and sources that section 4.4 says to record. I treated the "no" result as established and didn't hold the case back for that.
